map.文字颜色怎么选不糊？: How do you pick text colour that stays legible?
map.深底配白字 #ffffff 最稳；若主色很浅，文字改深色并保证对比度，小图才清晰: White text #ffffff on a dark background is the safest; if the main colour is very light, switch the text to a darker colour and guarantee contrast so it stays clear at small sizes.
map.算例一：默认双色的渐变中点: Example 1: gradient midpoint of the default two colors
map.默认 #ff6b35（255,107,53）与 #7c3aed（124,58,2: The defaults #ff6b35 (255,107,53) and #7c3aed (124,58,237) give a midpoint by per-channel average = ((255+124)/2, (107+58)/2, (53+237)/2) = (190, 83, 145), i.e. #be5391; sampling at (450,191) is close to that value (t≈0.4998 on the gradient axis).
map.算例二：黑白双色与压暗量: Example 2: black-and-white colors and the darkening amount
map.两色设为 #000000 与 #ffffff，中点 = (128,128,128: With the two colors set to #000000 and #ffffff, the midpoint = (128,128,128) = #808080. A white background inside the darkening bar is reduced by rgba(0,0,0,0.35) to 255×(1−0.35) = 165.75, displayed as 166 after rounding; the upper area outside the bar stays 255.
map.wrapText 用 split('') 逐字符测量宽度，不识别单词边界，长英文: wrapText uses split('') to measure width character by character and does not recognize word boundaries, so long English titles break mid-word; control the line breaks manually when you need clean wrapping.
map.标题太长会怎样？: What happens if the title is too long?
map.超过 4 行后第 5 行基线 306 已高于副标题的 300，文字会重叠；副标题: Beyond 4 lines, the 5th line baseline of 306 is above the subtitle's 300 and the text overlaps; the subtitle itself starts at 300 with a 32 px line height, so its 3rd line baseline of 364 covers the footer at y=350.
map.不会。画布写死 900×383，预览与导出使用同一个 canvas，像素一一对应: No. The canvas is fixed at 900×383, and preview and export share the same canvas with one-to-one pixels; changing text and colors only affects the content, not the resolution.
map.预览固定 900×383；下载时按所选尺寸等比放大后居中裁切，超出比例的部分会被: Preview is fixed at 900×383; downloads are scaled proportionally to the selected size and center-cropped, so excess is trimmed.
